_help: EMPTY until you add your study: the Study tab and study blocks stay hidden while 'subjects' is empty. To fill it, tell your AI 'add my study plan' (it follows AI_SETUP.md). exam_day + exam_name = the big countdown (or set any countdown with the command bar: big <what> <date>). mock_start (optional) switches rhythm.content -> rhythm.mock on that date. Weekday keys: 0=Mon ... 6=Sun. rhythm.content[weekday] = subject keys studied that day in order; times[weekday] = start time of each of those blocks; hours[subject] = block length ('2h', '1.5h', '45m'). subjects[key].items = sessions in order; the island shows the first one with done=null and sets done to the date when you tick it. Subject keys P/M/B/H/R drive colours and focus timers: reuse them for any subject and change 'name' (e.g. M -> 'Calculus').
